method: Reviewed current Sentence Transformers retrieve/rerank documentation and OpenAI Embeddings API reference. Ran the offline lesson verifier (19/19), the local-models follow-up verifier (16/16), existing curriculum tests, typecheck, and lint. No provider requests, historical benchmark rerun, or target-workload benchmark was performed.
limitations: The Sentence Transformers documentation establishes lexical-versus-dense retrieval options and demonstrates direct cross-encoder scoring for a small single-document collection; it does not establish acceptable latency or improved quality for this project's target corpus.
The OpenAI dimensions parameter applies to text-embedding-3 and later models; no dimension configurability is inferred for other providers or for BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5.

The 2026-10-09 corpus, latency, and memory values remain historical reports whose original request traces, full hardware snapshot, and scoring artifacts are unavailable here; they were not rerun and are not independently validated by this review.

No profiling data establishes which portion of the Chroma client path contributed most to its historical latency. No current semantic recall, ANN recall, production workload, or target-hardware measurement was conducted.
